objective: Build Model Gateway with Routing, Fallback and Civic Data Residency Policies (#1153)
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Deliver documented architecture and threat model covering component boundaries, data flows, failure modes, and residency guarantees
AC-2: Implement core domain model, provider-neutral adapters, and typed contracts with input validation
AC-3: Implement civic data residency policies (local-only, sovereign national, cross-border with scrubbing) and enforcement engine
AC-4: Implement multi-criteria model router (task risk, language, latency SLA, cost limits) and circuit breaker with deterministic non-LLM fallback
AC-5: Implement gateway telemetry, token/cost estimation, and safe observability without exposing raw citizen data
AC-6: Integrate model gateway into Civic Help Setu Assistant and provide accessible Admin/Assistant UI controls
AC-7: Deliver comprehensive test suite (unit, integration, resilience, concurrency, synthetic fixtures) passing with zero security lint regressions
non_goals: Do not claim official government integration, verification, legal authority, or guaranteed outcomes
Do not store or leak raw citizen PII or credentials in logs, prompts, or analytics
No autonomous statutory actions, benefit denials, or filing
